title: Lucide Manager configuration
description: Configuration for @finografic/lucide-manager. Package defaults (lucide-manager.defaults.json) and host overrides (lucide-manager.config.json) share this schema. Keep in sync with LucideManagerConfig in src/config/lucide-manager.config.types.ts.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation (not read at runtime).

iconsApi.description: Host icons API (external to lucide-manager). Browser calls GET/POST /api/icons-json here.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the host icons API server (no scheme). Example: localhost

port.description: TCP port of the host icons API server. Typical: 3001

manager.description: This package (lucide-manager) — picker UI dev server and related settings.

server.description: Vite dev server that serves the picker UI.

port.description: TCP port for the picker UI Vite dev server. Typical: 5199

openOnStart.description: Open the browser when the picker dev server starts.

appBranding.description: Optional host override for picker logo and title. Omitted keys fall back to package defaults.

title.description: Application title shown in the sidebar chrome.

showInSidebar.description: When false, hide logo and title from the sidebar (header row height is unchanged on the main pane).
